name: claude-usage
description: Shows Claude session and weekly quota usage as bars in the status bar.

commands.title: Claude Usage: Sign In With Browser
Claude Usage: Sign Out (Forget Browser Login)

claudeUsage.enabled.description: Show Claude quota usage in the status bar.

claudeUsage.pollSeconds.description: How often to refresh usage, in seconds. The extension backs off automatically on errors and skips polling while the window is not focused.

enumDescriptions: Use the Claude Code login when it has a usable token, otherwise use the browser login stored by this extension.
Only use the Claude Code login. Never prompt to sign in.
Only use this extension's own browser login.
claudeUsage.credentials.description: Where to get the access token.

claudeUsage.show.description: Which meters to show: the 5-hour session window, the 7-day window, per-model 7-day windows, and extra-usage spend.

claudeUsage.labelStyle.description: How each meter is labelled. Short labels take less room in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Always show how long ago the reading was taken.
Only show it once the reading is overdue or a backoff is in effect.
Never show it; the tooltip still has it.
claudeUsage.age.description: Show a chip with the age of the reading, which turns into a warning with a retry countdown while backing off.

claudeUsage.barWidth.description: Number of cells in each bar. Set to 0 to show percentages without a bar.

claudeUsage.barStyle.description: Glyphs used to draw the bars. Run "Claude Usage: Choose Bar Style" to preview these live in your status bar.
enumDescriptions: ●●○○○○ — circles, the most widely drawn shapes in UI fonts.
██░░░░ — block elements; solid but often font-fallback, so cells can mismatch.
##---- — plain ASCII, guaranteed to render anywhere.

claudeUsage.showReset.description: Append the time remaining until each window resets.

claudeUsage.warnAtPercent.description: Colour a meter as a warning at or above this percentage.

claudeUsage.criticalAtPercent.description: Colour a meter as critical at or above this percentage.

claudeUsage.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar to place the meters on.

claudeUsage.priority.description: Status bar priority. Higher numbers sit further left within the chosen side.
